communes: S.Julião, N.S. Da Anunciada E S.Maria Da Graça

blurb.text: A Setúbal Peninsula region first noticed for off-dry white wines from early-picked Muscat, and lately for dry reds and whites. The Arrábida hills have well-drained limestone soil. It also allows sparkling and liqueur wines.
